acceptanceCriteria: The doc-gates job runs make traceability-tests-test.
The owner posts ci-control-plane on the change's head SHA.
body: V1-0370 added the make traceability-tests-test target, which self-tests the traceability section nesting checker. .github/workflows/ci.yml:37 runs traceability-tests-check but not the self-test, so a regression in the checker is caught only locally. The change touches .github and needs the owner's ci-control-plane post (decision 0390).
title: CI does not run make traceability-tests-test
